summary: Payload CMS is a developer-first headless content management system and application framework built on Node.js. It allows you to manage structured content and build backend logic through code configuration rather than traditional monolithic interfaces. Content is typically exposed via generated APIs for use across various frontend applications.
goodFor: Developers who want a code-driven approach to content modelling and need a flexible backend framework alongside standard CMS capabilities.
watchOut: Because it relies heavily on programmatic configuration and code-based schemas, it requires software development expertise to set up and maintain rather than offering a purely no-code administration panel.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires a persistent server environment, a separate relational database, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
